request: Give Sarah access to the billing mailbox.
final_text:
I'll help you give Sarah access to the billing mailbox. First, I need to determine what type of access Sarah should have. 

Please choose the access type:
1. Full Read Access (can read/manage emails but NOT send as the mailbox owner)
2. Full Read Access + Send As (can read/manage emails AND send emails as the mailbox owner)
3. Full Read Access + Send on Behalf (can read/manage emails AND send emails on behalf of the mailbox owner)
4. Full Permissions (all three permissions)

Which option would you like for Sarah?
